name: ZCA_DAAS_MAPPINGS
description: Stores Daas attribute to CRM VO Attribute mappings.

columns.name: DAAS_ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute header returned by Data Cloud service

columns.name: DAAS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC
columns.description: Description of DAAS Attribute

columns.name: FUSION_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Viewobject name to which this DAAS attribute maps to.

columns.name: FUSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Attribute name in View Object to which this DAAS attribute maps to.

columns.name: DISPLAY_LABEL_KEY
columns.description: Resource bundle key

columns.name: AUTOFILL_BLANK
columns.description: If Y, updates value in CRM with Data Cloud value if CRM value is blank.

columns.name: AUTOUPDATE_NON_BLANK
columns.description: If Y, updates value in CRM with Data Cloud value if CRM value is not blank.

columns.name: DAAS_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies whether the attribute is account related or contact related.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: Resource bundle id.

columns.name: ORIG_FUSION_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Viewobject name to which this DAAS attribute maps to. Backup column.

columns.name: ORIG_FUSION_ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: Attribute name in View Object to which this DAAS attribute maps to. Backup column.

columns.name: ORIG_AUTOFILL_BLANK
columns.description: If Y, updates value in CRM with Data Cloud value if CRM value is blank. Backup column.

columns.name: ORIG_AUTOUPDATE_NON_BLANK
columns.description: If Y, updates value in CRM with Data Cloud value if CRM value is not blank. Backup column.

columns.name: ORIG_DAAS_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies whether the attribute is account related or contact related. Backup column.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: DAAS_GROUP_NO
columns.description: Indicates the row number in the data csv.

columns.name: DAAS_VALUE_STRING
columns.description: Indicates default value to be provided for Sales Cloud.

columns.name: DAAS_MANDATORY
columns.description: Indicates whether a child csv is to be generated by Data as a Service.

columns.name: SIMPLIFIED_IMP_OBJECT
columns.description: Stores the Simplified Import object that data csv is to be mapped.

columns.name: SIMPLIFIED_IMP_OBJ_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Stores the Simplified Import attribute that data csv is to be mapped.

columns.name: DAAS_PARENT_REFERENCE_ATTR
columns.description: Stores the parent identifier that each data row should have in the child data csv.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
